cache.method: owned-file msync(MS_SYNC|MS_INVALIDATE) immediately before sample, mincore confirms zero resident pages; independent App process

profiling.method: DuckDB EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, FORMAT JSON) using canonical navigation SQL and actual bound values; separate untimed probe

samples.backendMethod: union of matching native operation intervals; overlapping invocations counted once; prefetch excluded
samples.checkpointMethod: proc_pid_rusage diskio byteswritten delta around explicit CHECKPOINT; process-scoped

coldCache.method: owned-file MAP_SHARED + msync(MS_SYNC|MS_INVALIDATE), then mincore resident-bit census; preparation excluded from operation timing

samples.ioMethod: proc_pid_rusage RUSAGE_INFO_V2 process diskio byte deltas
samples.nativeWindowFocusMethod: Tauri window.is_focused at native begin and finish; DOM input focus is separate diagnostic evidence

retention.method: actual projectViewportBudget cache entries; UTF-16 retained payload estimate; single-table fixture

samples.rssMethod: proc_pidinfo PROC_PIDTASKINFO resident_size; main process sampled peak every5ms plus endpoints; WebContent process excluded
samples.transferredBytesMethod: serialized native reply payload bytes; excludes IPC envelope
samples.walMethod: project WAL file size after operation; absent file is zero

uiMethod: real App exact visible state followed by two animation frames; not compositor presentation timing
